question: Is endometriosis heritability more enriched in lesion-context than eutopic cell programs?
primary_test: S-LDSC (LDSC-SEG) + MAGMA on context-specific gene sets; lesion minus eutopic contrast
falsifier: Eutopic contexts equally/more enriched
status: ALTERNATIVE_BY_RULE with GCST (lymphocyte) but does NOT hold with KOLLER_EUR (Holm 0.36; perm 0.22); lesion-up never; eutopic-up tilts move across lineages/GWAS and occur for unrelated traits -> not endometriosis-specific; epithelial tilt (KOLLER) permutation p 0.069 (parametric 1.5e-04) -> no calibrated eutopic tilt

question: Is genetically predicted expression sign-concordant with lesion-vs-own-eutopic but not patient-vs-control eutopic differences?
primary_data: GCST90205183 harmonised; GSE141549 GPL13376 (ref P8 copy)
primary_test: Genome-wide concordance, LD-block permutation, paired within patient, medication covariate
falsifier: Eutopic concordance >= lesion concordance
status: OPEN; refocused v0.2.11 on sign concordance only (TWAS published: Koller 2026)

question: Do ovarian, peritoneal and deep endometriosis differ in genetic architecture?
primary_data: FinnGen R13 subtypes
primary_test: Part A: LDSC rg vs 1 (Holm, h2 z>=4 gate); Part B: G1 pipeline per subtype
falsifier: rg CI includes 1 and same profiles
status: PART_A_NOT_SUPPORTED (2026-11-05, v004); PART_B_OPEN

question: Does the published decidual-stroma enrichment survive an independent atlas, another method, leave-one-locus-out and the lesion-stroma contrast?
primary_data: GCST90205183; GSE266265 non-ENDO (ref P8 export); HECA
primary_test: S-LDSC/MAGMA phase x cell-type sets; leave-one-locus-out
falsifier: Survives all checks (robust decidual signal)
overlap_check: No disease DE in GSE266265; P8 export used read-only
status: GCST: not reproduced (Holm 0.25); KOLLER_EUR: criterion met (Holm 0.037) but NOT endometriosis-specific: T2D also meets it (Holm 0.019/0.044), not separable from perivascular/SMC (p 0.11), survives control gene z and MULL; M3 non-specific

question: Is the enrichment profile specific to endometriosis?
primary_data: FinnGen leiomyoma, adenomyosis, I9_HYPTENS, T2D
primary_test: Same pipeline as G1/G4
falsifier: Profile shared with leiomyoma
status: OPEN; pipeline specificity shown: leiomyoma->uSMC, hypertension->vascular (v014); G1 eutopic tilt shared by hypertension, not leiomyoma (v018)

question: Is endometriosis polygenic heritability concentrated in reproductive-tract tissues or elsewhere (GTEx v8)?
primary_data: GCST90205183; GTEx v8 gene median TPM (52 tissues)
primary_test: MAGMA gene-property per tissue conditioned on the across-tissue average; Holm over 6 reproductive tissues; BH over 52
falsifier: No reproductive tissue enriched
status: REPRODUCTIVE by rule; HOLDS with KOLLER_EUR (Uterus 1.1e-12); exploratory; HTN positive control FAILED, leiomyoma PASS

question: Is there enrichment in menstrual/shedding states?
primary_data: any atlas with menstrual samples
primary_test: descriptive
falsifier: n/a
status: EXPLORATORY

primary_data: FinnGen R13 OVARY, PERITONEUM

falsifier: No CC-GWAS locus at genome-wide significance
status: REGISTERED_NOT_RUN

question: Do ovarian vs peritoneal/deep subtypes load on different cell programs (decidual stroma vs lymphatic/vascular/mesothelial)?
primary_data: FinnGen R13 subtypes; GSE266265 CTL sets
primary_test: LDSC-SEG and MAGMA gene-property, descriptive; needs independent data to confirm
falsifier: n/a
status: NOT_CONSISTENT_ACROSS_METHODS (v013)

primary_data: FinnGen OVARY, LEIOMYOMA; HECA; GSE266265
primary_test: MAGMA gene-property conditional on leiomyoma gene z (or mtCOJO-style adjustment)
falsifier: Tilt disappears after conditioning
status: REGISTERED_NOT_RUN

question: Are endometriosis risk genes reproductive-tract (Muellerian) identity genes broadly expressed across endometrial cell types (organ identity rather than one cell type)?
primary_data: GCST90205183; GTEx v8; HECA control donors
primary_test: MAGMA: MULL | Average + SMOOTH; MULL within HECA breadth tertiles; dStromal | MULL
falsifier: MULL not significant beyond smooth muscle, or effect not larger in broadly expressed genes
status: Muellerian beyond smooth muscle YES (GCST 1.2e-05; KOLLER 9.3e-10); not endometriosis-specific (HTN 0.02); organ-identity NO in both GWAS

question: Does the published lesion-macrophage prioritization (Ochoa 2025, scDRS) hold with our labels, a larger GWAS and unrelated-trait controls?
primary_data: GSE213216 cells; GCST90205183; KOLLER_EUR; HYPERTENSION; T2D; LEIOMYOMA
primary_test: scDRS association test per lineage / fine label (lesion; eutopic descriptive)
falsifier: No macrophage/myeloid association after Holm, or equally present for HTN/T2D
status: NOT REPRODUCED (v025 our labels; v028 Ochoa-faithful: GCST Holm 0.365, KOLLER 0.739); donor-level macrophage excess shared by HTN and T2D (not leiomyoma); endometriosis scDRS strongest in endometrial-type stromal states (eF2/eF3/dS4), shared with leiomyoma

question: Can GWAS-based prioritization distinguish decidual stroma from perivascular/arterial/smooth-muscle programs?
primary_data: GCST90205183; KOLLER_EUR; controls HTN, T2D, LEIOMYOMA; HECA; GSE213216; GSE266265
primary_test: covariate correlation/VIF; pairwise conditional MAGMA; block jackknife; simulations with known source
falsifier: dStromal signal separable and simulations show low misassignment
status: SUPPORTED (resolution limit): dStromal_mid vs ePV_2 within-trait z 0.03; mutual attenuation; positive controls resolved; sims: true dS_mid at observed size detected 27% (Holm-3), ranked first 13%; ePV_2 source at 2x -> dS_mid Holm-3 37%

question: Are parametric gene-property tests for donor-estimated contrasts calibrated?
primary_data: GCST90205183; KOLLER_EUR; controls HTN, T2D, LEIOMYOMA; HECA; GSE213216; GSE266265
primary_test: FPR under random within-context splits; permutation; jackknife cross-trait differences
falsifier: FPR close to nominal 5%
status: SUPPORTED (miscalibration): true-null FPR 11-25% per direction (t SD 1.33-1.81) for donor contrasts; specificity covariates calibrated (3%)

question: Do published cell-state prioritizations (HECA, Koller, Ochoa) reproduce under their own methods and survive one-factor perturbations?
primary_data: GCST90205183; KOLLER_EUR; controls HTN, T2D, LEIOMYOMA; HECA; GSE213216; GSE266265
primary_test: method-matched re-analyses then one-factor changes (GWAS, labels, method, background, controls)
falsifier: claims reproduce and survive perturbations and control traits
status: Koller exact cohort reconstructed (K1c: 22/13 library-individual pairs, hormones included = v031 variant H): nominal and BH decidual result reproduce there; top annotation venous endothelium (q 0.01) in every variant; v047: full rule comparison, K4, K7, K8 repeated on the exact cohort with the same conclusions

question: Are endometriosis risk associations preferentially enriched in fallopian-tube secretory/ciliated programs relative to matched endometrial epithelial programs?
primary_data: KOLLER_EUR (primary); GCST; ENDO_OVARY; ENDO_PERITONEUM; controls; CELLxGENE 0436a180 (Weigert 2025) + HECA
primary_test: direct conditional/difference tests on an independent FT atlas (to be fixed)
falsifier: no FT-specific excess over endometrial epithelium
status: NOT SUPPORTED (v032): no tubal secretory or ciliated preference (KOLLER FT_SEC p 0.755, FT_CIL 0.784; jackknife p 0.11 / 0.09); POST HOC: tubal vs uterine stroma indistinguishable (difference p 0.46; mutual attenuation); stromal trend also in T2D

question: Does the cell type prioritized under the Koller pipeline depend on the gene-selection rule (|log2FC| vs up vs down), and is it separable from endothelial/perivascular programs by joint S-LDSC?
primary_data: KOLLER_EUR; GCST90205183; ENDO_ALL; HTN; T2D; LEIOMYOMA; HECA Mareckova
primary_test: S-LDSC families ABS/UP/DOWN; DOWN share of ABS sets; pairwise joint S-LDSC A|B and B|A
falsifier: H-ABS: endothelial ABS sets not DOWN-dominated, or endothelial sets top in UP, or not top in DOWN
status: H-ABS, H-SIGN, H-PAR NOT SUPPORTED by strict rules; 15/29 ABS-nominal annotations DOWN-carried; joint ABS vs UP reverses the answer; rotation simulations calibrated (2-3%): ABS recovers venous 72%, perivascular 15%, decidual 0-2%; UP 95%/67%/37%; strong decidual source detected 90-97% but ranked first 32-37%; no planted source reproduces the observed ABS venous top hit

question: Do endometriosis risk loci map to several endometrial compartments rather than one cell state (H-MULTI), and which compartments are enriched against the genome?
primary_data: KOLLER_EUR loci; HECA heca_v014 specificity; comparators GCST90205183, leiomyoma, hypertension, T2D
primary_test: locus -> compartment assignment (percentile >= 90); share distribution; binomial enrichment vs all expressed genes
falsifier: assigned loci concentrated in one compartment (> 50%) or fewer than 3 compartments with >= 10%
status: H-MULTI SUPPORTED (v040; 5 compartments, top 0.28) but not distinctive (leiomyoma 0.25, HTN 0.24, T2D 0.23); stroma loci enriched vs genome p 0.030, endothelium p 0.069

question: Which loci drive the aggregate cell-type rankings (|log2FC| venous top, up-only decidual top)?
primary_data: KOLLER_EUR genes.raw; v031 P sets
primary_test: leave-one-locus-out MAGMA gene-set analysis; driver = >= 10x p increase
falsifier: descriptive
status: no single driver; all loci removed -> ABS venous lost, UP decidual partly persists; L2c: stromal loci specifically carry the UP decidual signal (perm p 0.020); endothelial loci do not specifically carry the ABS venous hit (perm p 0.275); H-STRVEN registered (v044)

question: Which endometriosis loci are shared with leiomyoma, T2D, hypertension, and in which compartments?
primary_data: pval files of the four traits; 1000G EUR positions
primary_test: min p < 1e-5 within lead +- 250 kb
falsifier: descriptive
status: matched baseline: leiomyoma 46% vs 10% (OR 7.7, p 4e-10); T2D 42% vs 28% (OR 1.9, p 0.022); HTN 49% vs 30% (OR 2.3, p 0.0035)

question: Which marker rule recovers the cell type of a known genetic source, under truths that do and do not favour any rule, with calibrated FWER and size-matched sets?
primary_data: KOLLER_EUR genes.raw; HECA v031 P cells; heca_v014 truth profiles
primary_test: rotation benchmark: ABS/UP/DOWN, size-matched, continuous; 300 nulls; POS/NEG/EXPR truths x 3 targets
falsifier: P1-P4 as stated in CHANGELOG v0.2.30
status: DONE (v041): calibrated (FWER 0.3-1.7%); P1 YES, P2 YES, P3 NO, P4 exploratory YES; thresholded |log2FC| never best; direction of the true association decides the working rule; decidual stroma located to group, not exact state

question: Which families rank the expected cell group first for traits with known biology, and what do the seven families say on the real endometriosis GWAS?
primary_data: real genes.raw of 6 GWAS; v041 families
primary_test: top-1 group per family; expectations fixed in v0.2.33
falsifier: expected group not first in any family (leiomyoma)
status: DONE (v043): leiomyoma -> uSMCs first in UP, ABSN, UPN, SPEC, not ABS; HTN -> vascular first in ABS, UP, ABSN, UPN, SPEC; UPN KOLLER dStromal_mid 1.2e-06; SPEC decidual significant for T2D, not KOLLER

question: Do the marker-rule differences and positive controls hold in a non-reproductive atlas (GTEx v9 snRNA-seq)?
primary_data: GTEx v9 snRNA-seq (Eraslan 2022); six GWAS
primary_test: seven families per cell type; expected group first for leiomyoma and hypertension
falsifier: expected groups not first in any family
status: DONE (v044): leiomyoma -> smooth muscle first with UP, UPN, SPEC (not ABS: rank 7); hypertension pre-registered -> SPEC only (ABS/UP/ABSN/UPN first = 'contractile cell', label check v045); T2D adipocyte with UP, UPN (exploratory); contractile cell = Pericyte/SMC (v045 label check, post hoc) -> HTN vascular first with ABS, UP, ABSN, UPN, SPEC

question: Is the |log2FC| venous top hit carried by the stromal loci rather than the endothelial loci?
primary_data: KOLLER_EUR; v031 P sets; v042 loci
primary_test: remove 9 stromal / 8 endothelial loci vs 200 random 9-locus subsets
falsifier: stromal removal not above null or not above endothelial removal
status: SUPPORTED (v044): +1.35 vs +0.89, perm p 0.020; same loci carry UP decidual (p 0.005) and DOWN luminal/ciliated (p 0.005)

question: Are down-type marker families less trait-specific than up-type families?
primary_data: v043 HECA and v044 GTEx rankings; 4 traits
primary_test: cross-trait Spearman, down-type minus up-type, bootstrap CI
falsifier: difference <= 0 or CI includes 0 in either atlas
status: NOT SUPPORTED (v045): HECA -0.09 (CI -0.28 to 0.11); GTEx +0.20 (CI -0.00 to 0.39)

question: Are GTEx |log2FC| sets mostly depleted genes, and do |log2FC| rankings follow down-set rankings?
primary_data: GTEx v9 DE; v043/v044 rankings
primary_test: median depleted share; rho(ABS,DOWN) vs rho(ABS,UP)
falsifier: share <= 0.5 or < 4/6 traits in either atlas
status: NOT SUPPORTED (v045): GTEx depleted share 0.33; ABS rankings follow UP more than DOWN (HECA 6/6, GTEx 5/6 traits)

question: Do generic gene properties (expression level, breadth, LoF constraint) explain down-type signals more than up-type?
primary_data: HECA v041 DE, GTEx v044 DE; gnomAD v2.1.1
primary_test: MAGMA gene-property, binary indicators, conditioned vs base
falsifier: retained share not lower for down-type in both atlases
status: H-GENERIC NOT SUPPORTED (v045; retained down/up HECA 0.10/0.42, GTEx 0.41/0.25); H-DSTROMA SUPPORTED; top labels unchanged by conditioning

question: Are the top |log2FC| hits carried by their depleted-gene part?
primary_data: HECA v041 DE, GTEx v044 DE; 6 GWAS
primary_test: joint UP|DOWN and DOWN|UP for top-5 |log2FC| sets per trait
falsifier: < 50% DOWN-carried in either atlas
status: NOT SUPPORTED (v046): DOWN-carried share GTEx 0.33, HECA 0.37; depleted part contributes (DOWN|UP < 0.05) in 27/30 and 17/27

question: Is the leiomyoma control missed by |log2FC| because DOWN-carried sets outrank the expected group?
primary_data: HECA, GTEx; LEIOMYOMA
primary_test: classes of |log2FC| sets ranked above the expected group
falsifier: expected first, or < half DOWN-carried, in either atlas
status: NOT SUPPORTED (v046): HECA YES (1/1), GTEx NO (2/6 DOWN-carried, 4 both); masking of the true source replicated (uSMCs up part 4.7e-06 vs |log2FC| 0.027)

question: In Koller's exact cohort and S-LDSC pipeline, does the first-ranked cell type flip with the selection rule, and does |log2FC| miss the leiomyoma control?
primary_data: HECA variant H (22/13); KOLLER_EUR, GCST90205183, ENDO_ALL, LEIOMYOMA, HYPERTENSION
primary_test: S-LDSC |log2FC| / up-only / down-only; first-ranked annotation
falsifier: |log2FC| first not endothelial, or up-only first not decidual stroma, or leiomyoma smooth muscle not first with up-only / first with |log2FC|
status: SUPPORTED (v047): |log2FC| first Venous/ENDO (q 0.01); up-only first dStromal_mid/ENDO (p 1.6e-03, q 0.08); leiomyoma uSMCs rank 1 up-only (nominal, q 0.53) vs rank 8 |log2FC|; K4/K7/K8 as variant P

question: Do the rule flip and the leiomyoma control hold across thresholds and set sizes?
primary_data: HECA v041 DE; KOLLER_EUR, GCST, LEIOMYOMA, HTN
primary_test: first-ranked label over 8 threshold settings and 3 sizes
falsifier: H-ROBUST-FLIP / H-ROBUST-CTRL counts below 6/8
status: H-ROBUST-FLIP NOT SUPPORTED by rule (decidual first up-only 5/8; stromal 8/8); H-ROBUST-CTRL SUPPORTED (uSMCs up-only 8/8 vs |log2FC| 2/8)

question: Is decidual-stroma enrichment larger for endometriosis than for T2D and hypertension?

question: Where are the genes of the 57 endometriosis loci expressed across endometrial cell states?

question: Is the stromal (eF3) signal separable from perivascular and mesothelial programs?
primary_data: GSE266265 UPN sets; KOLLER_EUR
primary_test: joint MAGMA, eF3 given each other set
falsifier: eF3 p >= 0.05 given any perivascular / mesothelial set
status: SUPPORTED (v051): eF3 survives every perivascular / mesothelial set (KOLLER 1e-04 to 3e-04); perivascular also survives eF3 (two separable signals)

question: Do endometriosis risk genes favour endometrial-type stroma over real peritoneal mesothelium and peritoneal fibroblasts?

question: Is the GSE266265 eF3 signal robust to generic gene properties?

status: SUPPORTED (v052): eF3 KOLLER 6.7e-05 -> 2.5e-03 after Average + Breadth + LOEUF

question: Do the trait contrasts survive the dependence between GWAS estimates?

falsifier: descriptive

question: Do stromal loci defined in one atlas carry the stromal signal of the other atlas?

status: SUPPORTED (v054): kappa 0.77; 7/9 HECA-stromal loci stromal in GSE266265; perm p 0.005 in both directions (+1.22 and +0.98 log10)

question: Does the GSE266265 stromal (eF3) result depend on single donors?
primary_data: GSE266265 pseudobulk, 60 donors

status: NOT SUPPORTED (v054): stroma first KOLLER 48/60, GCST 60/60, ENDO_ALL 54/60; eF3 p <= 1e-03 in all 60 runs; Prv-MYH11 near-tie

question: Does the HECA decidual (dStromal_mid/ENDO) result depend on single ENDO donors?

question: Does a donor-level DE in HECA keep stroma first?

falsifier: first KOLLER UPN state not stromal
status: NOT SUPPORTED (v054): ePV_1b/ENDO first p 0.02; 3-7 donors per state; sets Jaccard 0.05 vs cell-level

question: How precise are the benchmark recovery rates and family differences?

question: How many donors make up each HECA status x label group?

falsifier: descriptive

question: With labels pooled over status and donors balanced, is a stromal state still first?

question: Do the genes of the endometriosis risk loci keep their endometrial compartment inside peritoneal lesions and endometriomas?

question: Are stromal-locus genes higher in endometrial-type stroma than in the stroma of unaffected peritoneum?
